split: First 40 percent of rows for fitting only, last 60 percent in eight consecutive batches. At each nominal cut advance to the end of ties. Preserve original chronology.
models: Training-only median imputation, discard columns entirely missing in training. Logistic standardized C=1, max_iter=1000. Random forest and CatBoost 96 trees depth 6; CatBoost learning rate 0.05. All balanced by training class, seed 17, single-thread. Use threshold 0.5 including ensemble mean of three probabilities.
feedback: After predicting each full batch, simulate all inspection labels arriving before the next batch. Choose maximum mean binary macro-F1 across previously returned batches, tie by listed order. Freeze-once control uses only the first batch. No refitting or parameter search.
score: Pooled binary macro-F1 with both class labels fixed and zero for undefined F1. Also report failed-product recall, false positives, per-batch and worst-batch macro-F1 and training time.
accept: Require at least +0.01 pooled macro-F1 over every fixed arm and choose-once, with failure recall and worst-batch macro-F1 no more than 0.01 lower than the best pooled fixed. Otherwise keep research only.
